chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin kote in lunghimawhin ka thuak zawh nawn loh uh ciangin Athen khuapi-ah komau bek ka om lai nading uh ka ut uh hi.

Khazih’ Lungdamna Thu hilhin, i sanggampa Timoti note kiangah ka hong sawl uh hi. Hih gimnate hangin kuamah a lungkiat loh nadingin, note hong kipsak a, na upna uh ah note hong hansuah nadingin amah ka hong sawl uh hi.
Hih gimnate thuak dingin kote hong kikoih hi ci-in nomau mah in na thei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in gimna i thuak ding hi ci-in note tawh ka omkhawm lai takun ka hong gen zo uh hi. Kong gen uh mah bangin zong a piang hi ci-in na thei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a ze-et thei, a zol theipa in no hong ze-et a, ka sepna un a mawkna a suak kha ding hi ci-in lunghimawhin ka thuak zawh nawn loh ciangin, note upna ka theih nadingin ka hong sawl hi.

Tu-in ahih leh, Timoti in note kiang pan hong ciahkik a, note upna leh ki-itna uh a kip hi ci-in ahi zongin, kote in note kong ngaih uh mah bangin note in kote hang ngai-in, ni simin hong ngaihsun a, hong phawk uh hi ci-in ahi zongin, lungdam thu hong zasak ahih ciangin,
ute naute aw, kote in lunghihmawhna khempeuh leh ko thuak gimna-ah note thu-upna uh hangin hehnepna ka ngah uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in Topa sungah na kip uh leh, kote ka nungta uh hi.
I Pasian mai-ah note thu hangah kote lungdamna khempeuh ngaihsunin, note hangin Pasian’ hehpihna bang ci thukkik zawh ding ka hi uh hiam?
Note maitang uh mu-in, nomau’ kisap lai khempeuh a kicin’sak nadingun kote in sun tawh zan tawh nakpi-in thu ka ngenngen uh hi.
Note omna-ah ka hong pai nading lampi i Pa Pasian mahmah leh i Topa Zeisu in hong bawlsak ta hen.

Tua Topa in a misiangthote tawh a hong kumsuk khawm ciangin, eite Pa Pasian mai-ah Topa in amau lungsim sian’thona-ah mawhsak nading om loin, a kipsak nadingin, kote in note kong it uh mah bangin note khat leh khat ahi zongin, mi khempeuh ahi zongin na itin, ki-itna ah khangin na kicin’ nadingun Pasian in hong bawl ta hen.
